text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, I'm offbeat again...!  
I just can't seem to catch the rhythm. 
Why is it so hard?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see. It is most likely due to 
this song's rather intricate composition.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I believe it best to drill the fundamental 
movements first. 
—To the beat of a taiko drum.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Huh, a taiko drum?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is a method I often employ. 
Please listen to the track first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Don-doko! Don-doko! Don-doko!)

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! You're right! It really is taiko 
drums! 
That's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't it? Since this audio track 
features only drums, 
you will not be led astray by other 
sounds.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Focus on this sound, and let us 
review the movements first. Come—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Don-doko! Don-doko! Don-doko!)

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hmph, hah... —Teyaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I walked past the dance studio, 
it seemed Phalaenopsis and the others were 
in the middle of a dance lesson, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two danced to the thunderous rhythm of 
the Japanese drums, 
moving with the gallant grace of true 
samurai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wadaiko and modern dance—it was a rare 
combination, yet they blended seamlessly. 
What an innovative performance...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oho, now this is... intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Ah, Air Groove-chan!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Dancing to traditional drums 
is certainly a fresh, innovative 
performance. 
Where do you plan to unveil it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Unveil it? No—this is merely a means 
of training. We have no plans to perform 
it publicly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What? That would be a complete waste.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, allow me to include it 
in our upcoming event. 
I would love for you to perform this 
before an audience.
choice_data_list: I think that's a great idea too!
I think that's a great idea too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a truly mesmerizing performance. 
I told Phalaenopsis and the others that it 
would be a shame 
to let it end as mere practice.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I am honored that you like it. 
If that is the case, then by all means.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll do my best too! 
I'm gonna practice tons before the big 
day~~!

text_block_list.text:

I'm gonna practice tons before the big 
day~~!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see—ah, 
then could you help us brainstorm the 
outfits?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Since we have this chance, traditional 
Japanese attire would be fitting. 
I'd like to pay close attention to the 
fabric and tailoring as well.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, love it, love it~! I want 
something cool, like a samurai~!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that sounds wonderful. —Well then, 
Trainer, 
we leave that direction in your capable 
hands.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
A DJ!? 
Whoa, that sounds so cool~!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha, taiko paired with a DJ! That sounds 
brilliant as well! 
Then we shall leave future track 
selections to you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Something fierce and gallant, like war 
drums 
capable of scattering all doubt to the 
wind— 
we are counting on you!
